The '''LongView-341.A''' was a [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]]. It was a scaled-down version of the [[LongView-382.X]] long-range sensor array and was employed by [[All Terrain Force Reconnaissance Walker/Legends|All Terrain Force Reconnaissance Walkers]].
